# Step 7: Evaluation (robustness checks)

*Generated by `agent-tips evaluate` from `outputs/results/robustness.json`. Checks follow the frozen plan `docs/01_problem_and_hypotheses.md`.*

## In plain words

- **P1 holds up.** However the older AI's model-version batches are drawn, reproducing first costs -2.8 to -4.0 points, and every 95% CI stays below zero (highest upper end -0.3).
- **Undated tries (all failures) do not change P1** unless they are placed in the most unfavourable way possible: added back like other failures the effect is -3.1; the extreme bounds are -1.4 and -5.4.
- **P2 holds up.** Dropping any one newer AI keeps every 90% CI inside ±2 points (-0.6 to +0.7). Counting any new file before the fix as test first gives +0.4 [-0.2, +0.9].
- **The weakest point of P2 is NVIDIA's filtering.** If test-first tries had lost 5% more hidden failures than fix-first tries, the result would reach −2 points. In Nebius's unfiltered data, the share of tries such filtering would remove differs by -2.3 points, test first minus fix first (95% CI -5.4 to +0.6). Test-first tries would be removed less often, so if anything the filter works against testing first. Even the upper end of that interval is below the 5% needed.
- **Reproducible:** two full runs give identical result tables.

### Undated tries

Some older-AI tries have no evaluation time, and all of them are unresolved. They cannot be put in a batch, so the main analysis leaves them out. Here they are added back to a batch of their issue in four ways.

| Scenario | Batches = day | Batches = hour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| left out (main analysis) | -3.5 | -3.7 |
| added back like other failures (median of draws) | -3.1 | -3.3 |
| added back, worst case for the finding | -1.4 | +0.6 |
| added back, best case for the finding | -5.4 | -9.7 |

The worst and best cases place each undated failure, one at a time, where it moves the estimate most. These are extreme bounds, not plausible values.

### Label errors

The labeler never calls a file a test script by mistake (precision 100%) but misses about a quarter of them (recall 73%, `docs/05_feature_report.md`). A miss can only move a try between groups if the try made a new file before its fix and had no other test script. Such tries are moved at random to *test first*:

| Tries moved | Estimate (pts), median of draws | Range over draws |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 25% of 7707 moved | +0.1 | -0.1 to +0.3 |
| 50% of 7707 moved | +0.2 | +0.0 to +0.5 |
| 100% of 7707 moved | +0.4 | +0.4 to +0.4 |
| broad definition (all moved), with CI | +0.4 [-0.2, +0.9] | — |

### NVIDIA's removed tries

NVIDIA removed tries that hit the step limit or made no patch. These are hidden failures. If test-first tries lost more of them, P2 is biased in favour of testing first.

- **Tipping point:** test-first tries would need 5.2% extra hidden failures (relative to their visible count, in every issue) to move the estimate from +0.1 to −2 points.
- **Calibration:** in the unfiltered Nebius newer-AI data, the share of tries that NVIDIA-style filtering would remove differs by -2.3 [-5.4, +0.6] points (test first minus fix first, same issue; 273 issues). Only Nebius issues where both orders occur count, so this number is uncertain.

## Cross-check: conditional logistic regression

The same comparisons as odds ratios, conditional on the group (below 1 means the tip lowers the chance of fixing the bug).

| Hypothesis | Odds ratio [95% CI] | p |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P1 | 0.612 [0.524, 0.715] | 5.75e-10 |
| P2 | 1.018 [0.906, 1.144] | 0.766 |
